headline: Revenue surges and margins expand as losses nearly disappear
summary_short: Caris Life Sciences reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $263.7 million, up 45% y/y on 55% growth in molecular profiling services, with gross margin expanding to 68% and net loss narrowing to $0.6 million from $71.8 million a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue rose 45% y/y and 22% q/q to $263.7M, driven by 55% growth in molecular profiling services on higher case volume (~59,200 cases, +18% y/y, +12% q/q) and ASP gains. Gross margin expanded ~500bps to 68%. Operating income swung to $26.9M from an $18.0M loss a year ago as revenue growth outpaced a 16% rise in opex. Net loss narrowed to $0.6M from $71.8M, helped by the operating swing and no recurrence of a prior-year $17.9M fair-value charge. Adjusted EBITDA was $55.7M; free cash flow was $6.4M. Caris raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $1.03-$1.04B (27-28% growth) and reaffirmed ~20% clinical therapy selection volume growth guidance. Cash was $690.9M; long-term debt rose to $392.7M after refinancing the term loan.

Operating income swung from an $18.0M loss to $26.9M income and a prior-year $17.9M fair-value charge on financial instruments did not recur, partly offset by higher other expense.

CEO attributes the 12% sequential case-volume increase to sustained demand and payoff from investments in the commercial engine.
